desc: We are enclosing herewith copy of the Newspaper Advertisement for intimation of opening of Single Window for Transfer and Dematerialisation of shares pending before 2019 published on 26.08.2026 in Business Line (English) and Dinamani (Tamil)

We enclose herewith a copy of the Notice of the 116th Annual General Meeting to be held on Friday, the 25th September 2026 at 12:05 P.M India Standard Time("IST") through Video Conferencing ("VC") / Other Audio Visual Means ("OAVM").
We are enclosing herewith copies of 116th Annual General Meeting Notice published on 27.08.2026 in Business Line (English) and Dinamani (Tamil).

We would like to inform you that the Company has fixed the Record Date as 18.09.2026 for the purpose of payment of Dividend for the year 2025-2026.

The Board of Directors of the Company have recommended a Dividend at 10% (Rs.10/- per Equity share of Rs.100/- each) for the financial year ended 31.03.2026.
Book Closure and Record Date Intimation

Pursuant to Regulation 36(1) (b) of the SEBI (LORD) Regulations, 2015 the Company has sent a letter providing a web-link, including the exact path of the Annual report 2025-2026, to those Members who have not registered their e-mail address with the company/Depositories. A copy of the letter is enclosed for your record and is also available on the website of the Company.
We are enclosing the Annual Report for the year 2025-2026 for your records.

Pursuant to Regulation 34 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. we attach herewith a copy of the Annual Report of the Company for the year 2025-26 for your records.

A copy of the Annual Report is also available on the website of the Company viz., www.lakshmimills.com
We are enclosing copies of 116th Annual General Meeting and E-voting Information published on 02.09.2026 in Dinamani (Tamil) and Business Line (English).
